# Plans and billing

Northwind has three plans. Free: up to 3 projects and 5 members. Team: $12 per member per month billed monthly, or $10 per member per month billed annually, with unlimited projects. Enterprise: custom pricing, adds SAML SSO, audit logs, and a 99.9% uptime SLA.

Invoices are issued on the 1st of each month and sent to the billing contact. Workspace owners can change the billing contact under Settings > Billing > Billing contact. We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and bank transfer (Enterprise only).

Adding a member mid-cycle is prorated to the day. Removing a member credits the unused days to your next invoice; credits are not paid out as cash.

# Refunds and cancellation

You can cancel at any time from Settings > Billing > Cancel plan. Your workspace stays on the paid plan until the end of the current billing period, then moves to Free.

Annual plans can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. After 14 days, annual plans are not refundable but you keep access until the term ends. Monthly plans are not refunded for partial months.

To request a refund, the workspace owner must email billing@northwind.example from the owner's account email address, including the workspace URL.

context:
# Single sign-on (SSO)

SAML SSO is available on the Enterprise plan. Supported identity providers are Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, and OneLogin.

To configure SSO, a workspace owner opens Settings > Security > SSO, copies the ACS URL and Entity ID into the identity provider, then uploads the provider's metadata XML. Test the connection before enforcing SSO. Once SSO is enforced, members can no longer sign in with a password; owners keep a password fallback in case the identity provider is down.

SCIM user provisioning is available for Okta and Entra ID. SCIM tokens expire after 365 days and must be regenerated under Settings > Security > SCIM.

text: Deleted projects can always be restored by support, even after the trash has been emptied.
context:
# Exporting data

Any member can export a single project as CSV from the project menu > Export. Workspace owners can export the whole workspace as JSON from Settings > Data > Export workspace. Workspace exports are prepared in the background and a download link is emailed to the owner; the link expires after 7 days.

Attachments are not included in CSV exports. JSON workspace exports include attachments as signed URLs that are valid for 7 days.

Deleted projects stay in the trash for 30 days and can be restored by any workspace admin. After 30 days they are permanently deleted and cannot be recovered by support.

context:
# API and rate limits

The REST API is available on Team and Enterprise plans. Create a personal access token under Profile > Developer > Tokens. Tokens are shown once at creation; store them securely. Revoke a token from the same page.

Rate limits are 100 requests per minute per token on Team and 600 requests per minute per token on Enterprise. When you exceed the limit the API returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header in seconds.

Webhooks can be configured per project and deliver events for task created, task updated, task completed, and comment added. Failed webhook deliveries are retried 5 times with exponential backoff over about 2 hours, then the webhook is disabled and the project owner is emailed.
